anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of On Pascha exists (Toura 1941; Daly ACW 54 and Witte's German are copyrighted and were not copied). Sense checked against the locked Witte Greek (and, for 1.94, Victor of Capua's Latin as Witte prints it) and the wording of the cited scriptures.

apparatus: Apparatus 18 L. ca. 3 Z. Insertion <ταύτης ἀλλὰ τῆς πρὸ>.
Mostly unrestored or heavily restored Greek; English does not fill gaps.
pass_a_gloss: But if he is already building this house as a second or third [gap], the first not belonging to this house but to the one built before this because of also first-ly.
pass_b_english: But if [he is already building this house as a second or] third [lacuna], the first the house does not [have], but the one built before this, because of [its being first as well].
source_text: Εἰ δὲ [δευτέραν ἤδη ἢ] τρίτην [ταύτην τὴν οἰκί]αν [οἰκοδομεῖ, ... ]μὲν ... ρ ... χεσθ[ ... ,] τὸ δὲ π[ρ]ῶ[τον] οὐκ [ἐχούση]ς τῆς οἰκίας <ταύτης ἀλλὰ τῆς πρὸ> [τ]αύτ[ης οἰκοδομ]ηθείσης [διὰ] τὸ κ[αὶ πρώτω]ς.
